subject: Trading
title: Patterns Are Probabilities
description: A short lesson to help you apply Patterns Are Probabilities.

hook.text: No chart pattern works every time. The best patterns succeed maybe 60–70% of the time. That's the reality.

buildup.text: A head and shoulders fails 30% of the time. Breakouts fail 40% of the time. No pattern is a guarantee.

discovery.text: Patterns give you an edge—a slight probability tilt. Over hundreds of trades, that edge compounds.

twist.text: Any single trade can lose regardless of the pattern. Risk management matters more than pattern selection.

climax.text: Professional traders think in probabilities, not certainties. They accept losses as the cost of doing business.

punchline.text: Trade the edge, not the outcome.

quiz.question: How should traders view chart patterns?
options: As probability tilts that require risk management
